1: // Simple Asteroid Dodger game
2: // Assumes a <canvas id="game"></canvas> exists in the page.

4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 400;
9:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
10: 
11:   // Ship configuration
12:   const ship = {
13:     w: 40,
14:     h: 20,
15:     x: width / 2 - 20,
16:     y: height - 30,
17:     speed: 5,
18:   };
19: 
20:   // Game state
21:   const bullets = [];
22:   const asteroids = [];
23:   let score = 0;
24:   let lives = 3;
25:   let gameOver = false;
26: 
27:   // Input handling
28:   const keys = {};
29:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
30:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
31: 
32:   function spawnAsteroid() {
33:     const size = Math.random() * 30 + 20;
34:     asteroids.push({
35:       x: Math.random() * (width - size),
36:       y: -size,
37:       w: size,
38:       h: size,
39:       speed: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
40:     });
41:   }
42: 
43:   function update() {
44:     if (gameOver) return;
45:     // Move ship
46:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x = Math.max(0, ship.x - ship.speed);
47:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.x = Math.min(width - ship.w, ship.x + ship.speed);
48:     // Fire bullet
49:     if (keys[' '] && bullets.length < 5) {
50:       bullets.push({
51:         x: ship.x + ship.w / 2 - 2,
52:         y: ship.y,
53:         w: 4,
54:         h: 10,
55:         speed: 7,
56:       });
57:     }
58:     // Update bullets
59:     bullets.forEach(b => b.y -= b.speed);
60:     // Remove off‑screen bullets
61:     for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
62:       if (bullets[i].y + bullets[i].h < 0) bullets.splice(i, 1);
63:     }
64:     // Update asteroids
65:     asteroids.forEach(a => a.y += a.speed);
66:     // Collision detection
67:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
68:       const a = asteroids[i];
69:       // Ship collision
70:       if (
71:         a.x < ship.x + ship.w && a.x + a.w > ship.x &&
72:         a.y < ship.y + ship.h && a.y + a.h > ship.y
73:       ) {
74:         lives--;
75:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
76:         if (lives <= 0) {
77:           gameOver = true;
78:         }
79:         continue;
80:       }
81:       // Bullet collision
82:       for (let j = bullets.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
83:         const b = bullets[j];
84:         if (
85:           a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x &&
86:           a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y
87:         ) {
88:           score++;
89:           asteroids.splice(i, 1);
90:           bullets.splice(j, 1);
91:           break;
92:         }
93:       }
94:     }
95:     // Remove off‑screen asteroids
96:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
97:       if (asteroids[i].y > height) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
98:     }
99:     // Randomly spawn new asteroids
100:     if (Math.random() < 0.02) spawnAsteroid();
101:   }
102:

111:     // Asteroids
112:     ctx.fillStyle = '#a44';
113:     asteroids.forEach(a => ctx.fillRect(a.x, a.y, a.w, a.h));
114:     // HUD
115:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
116:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
117:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
118:     ctx.fillText(`Lives: ${lives}`, width - 80, 20);
119:     if (gameOver) {
120:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
121:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
122:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
123:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
